task.description: Set up benchmark environment and verify `zig build bench` exits 0 for this run. If BPM_DB_URL or related benchmark prerequisites are missing, configure them for the project test PostgreSQL environment and re-run bench until clean. Record exact command/output summary and any env assumptions in result.

result.summary: Configured benchmark DB URL for test PostgreSQL and verified benchmark suite passes. Command: $env:BPM_DB_URL='postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test'; zig build bench; Write-Host "BENCH_EXIT_CODE=$LASTEXITCODE". Key output: BENCHMARK_SETUP_INFO|db_url_source=BPM_DB_URL, NFR_BENCH_SUMMARY|overall_passed=true, BENCH_EXIT_CODE=0. Assumption: local PostgreSQL test instance is available at localhost:5433/bpm_test.
